{
  "project_id": "P-JOR-InnovativeStartupsSMEsFund2",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Target private capital mobilization of US$150 million may not be achieved, limiting the fund’s impact on startups and job creation.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Expand outreach to additional regional and international VC funds, set quarterly mobilization targets, and activate a rapid‑response pipeline to attract new investors when shortfalls appear.",
      "evidence": "Section 20 – PDO expects US$150 million private capital mobilized."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Concentration of investments in a single VC fund could expose the ISSF to high loss if that fund underperforms.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce updated concentration limits (no more than 15 % of total loan per fund), regularly monitor exposure, and diversify across multiple funds and stages.",
      "evidence": "Section 34 – Concentration risk management caps at US$5 million / 30 % ownership."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Turnover of key ISSF staff or board members could disrupt project implementation and governance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement retention contracts, succession planning, and a formal nomination process to ensure timely replacement of board members.",
      "evidence": "Section 41 – Lessons learned on high turnover and need for stable team."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Insufficient operational due diligence (ODD) on underlying VC funds may allow fraud, mismanagement, or regulatory breaches.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate a robust ODD framework, conduct periodic third‑party audits of VC funds, and train ISSF staff on ODD best practices.",
      "evidence": "Section 41 – ODD will be integrated to assess compliance and governance."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Climate‑related extreme events could disrupt startup operations, especially those not focused on greentech.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize investments in greentech and climate‑resilient solutions; include climate risk assessment in investment screening.",
      "evidence": "Section 12 – Climate vulnerability noted but deemed low impact."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Improper e‑waste handling by ICT‑focused SMEs could cause pollution and health hazards.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Require funded startups to adopt certified e‑waste recycling plans and embed ESG clauses in investment agreements.",
      "evidence": "Section 77 – Potential environmental impacts from e‑waste mismanagement."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Startups may face data‑privacy and cybersecurity breaches, harming users and reputations.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Mandate compliance with international data‑protection standards (e.g., GDPR/ISO 27001) and provide cybersecurity capacity‑building grants.",
      "evidence": "Section 78 – Risks include data privacy and security concerns."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "A regional or global downturn in venture‑capital markets could reduce follow‑on funding and returns.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Diversify investments across stages, sectors, and geographies; maintain a reserve fund to support portfolio companies during market stress.",
      "evidence": "Section 59 – Acknowledgement of global VC downturn but portfolio performance remains promising."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Insufficient successful exits may limit the fund’s financial returns and ability to recycle capital.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Select startups with clear exit pathways, engage strategic corporate investors early, and allocate follow‑on capital to accelerate growth.",
      "evidence": "Section 14 – Only two exits to date; expectation of more in coming years."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Regulatory changes in the fintech sandbox or other sectors could render invested business models non‑compliant.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain continuous liaison with MODEE and other regulators; embed regulatory compliance checks in due‑diligence.",
      "evidence": "Section 25 – Fintech Regulatory Sandbox re‑launched with growing demand."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "The project may fail to meet its gender‑inclusion targets, reducing impact on women’s economic participation.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a Gender Action Plan with dedicated outreach, mentorship programs for women entrepreneurs, and performance‑based incentives for VC funds.",
      "evidence": "Section 49 – Goal of at least 30 % women‑owned/led beneficiaries; current 26 % women‑led."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "The existing grievance mechanism may not be accessible to all stakeholders, leading to unresolved complaints.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade GM procedures, add multilingual channels, train staff on handling complaints, and publish quarterly grievance reports.",
      "evidence": "Section 82 – GM system requires enhancement to ensure accessibility."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Procurement processes could face delays or non‑compliance due to under‑developed tools and templates.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint a qualified procurement specialist, adopt standard World Bank procurement documents, and conduct annual ex‑post reviews.",
      "evidence": "Section 74 – Procurement risk rated Moderate; tools under development."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Exchange‑rate fluctuations between USD (loan currency) and JOD (local expenditures) could affect project budgeting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Use forward‑exchange contracts or currency hedges and maintain a contingency buffer in the budget.",
      "evidence": "Datasheet – Currency equivalents JOD 0.709 = $US1; disbursements in USD (Section 69)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delays in World Bank disbursements or IFR approvals could postpone investment commitments.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare IFRs ahead of schedule, assign a dedicated liaison officer with MOPIC, and monitor disbursement timelines weekly.",
      "evidence": "Section 70 – Disbursement based on quarterly IFRs submitted within 45 days."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Jordanian labor law gaps relative to ESS2 (e.g., non‑discrimination) may expose the project to compliance issues.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement gap‑filling measures outlined in the ESCP, conduct regular labor‑law compliance audits, and train employers on non‑discrimination policies.",
      "evidence": "Section 80 – Identified gaps with ESS2 and added gap‑filling measures."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Overlap of exposure to the same startup through both Fund‑of‑Funds and co‑investment components could amplify loss.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain a centralized exposure register, set a maximum aggregate exposure per startup (e.g., 10 % of total capital), and require independent review before additional investment.",
      "evidence": "Section 36 – Risks related to total exposure to the same startups through both components."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Geopolitical volatility in the region may deter foreign investors and affect capital inflows.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Broaden the investor base to include regional sovereign wealth funds, obtain political‑risk insurance, and highlight Jordan’s stable macro‑economic reforms in marketing materials.",
      "evidence": "Section 1 – Jordan faces vulnerabilities tied to its position in a geopolitically volatile region."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Target private capital mobilization of US$150 million may not be achieved, limiting the fund’s impact on startups and job creation.
risks.mitigation: Expand outreach to additional regional and international VC funds, set quarterly mobilization targets, and activate a rapid‑response pipeline to attract new investors when shortfalls appear.
risks.evidence: Section 20 – PDO expects US$150 million private capital mobilized.

risks.description: Concentration of investments in a single VC fund could expose the ISSF to high loss if that fund underperforms.
risks.mitigation: Enforce updated concentration limits (no more than 15 % of total loan per fund), regularly monitor exposure, and diversify across multiple funds and stages.
risks.evidence: Section 34 – Concentration risk management caps at US$5 million / 30 % ownership.

risks.description: Turnover of key ISSF staff or board members could disrupt project implementation and governance.

risks.evidence: Section 41 – ODD will be integrated to assess compliance and governance.
